Implementing or modifying HOW evaluation, Jev adapter, promotion, rollback or policy publication (BB-059) or @exharness/benchmark internals (BB-065).
Live model-effectiveness claims, paid experiments or a universal numeric improvement threshold.
LangMem, DSPy, LangGraph, gepa[full] or any memory/optimizer/workflow platform in v1; an optimizer fork.

constraints: RESEARCH_SA reuses closed BB-083 research and probe evidence and consumes READY BB-059/BB-065 plans and the BB-085 desired contract as design inputs; the Worker binds only DONE BB-085, BB-059 and BB-065 package-root exports.
Pattern projection is deterministic and read-only over FeedbackResolution refs; it persists no mutable pattern state and mutates no lifecycle, acceptance or policy head.
Node owns all side effects, benchmark reservation, reconciliation and accounting; Python owns only pinned GEPA optimizer computation.
HOW_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL_V1 carries no accepted/promoted authority; only delivered BB-059 independent authority can promote.
The final holdout, metric policy and minEffect are fixed before search and never exposed to GEPA, reflection or candidate producer.
invariants: Pattern, reinforcement, optimizer and proposal outputs are evidence or proposals only and cannot mutate response, acceptance, promotion or policy state.
Support is counted once per distinct observation set; SYSTEMIC requires mechanism evidence covering every supporting episode, never frequency alone.
No benchmark attempt is dispatched without a prior Node-owned reservation, and crash, cancellation or unknown usage never duplicates dispatch, refunds budget or becomes success.
Promotion requires independent BB-059 evaluation over sealed, pre-frozen partitions; per-case critical regression or missing evidence is never success.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Product modules in packages/agentic-system/src: improvement-pattern.js (projectImprovementPatterns, PATTERN_POLICY_V1) and improvement-proposal.js (HOW_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL_V1, IMPROVEMENT_EVALUATION_HANDOFF_V1, buildHowEvolutionHandoff). Offline tooling in scripts/self-improve: gepa-bridge.mjs, gepa_adapter.py, requirements.lock. The product package has no Python/GEPA runtime dependency.

D2 — Input is a set of FEEDBACK_RESOLUTION_V1 refs resolved through the delivered BB-085 exports. SUPERSEDED resolutions contribute only through their successor; the projection reads episodes, responses and outcomes by exact ref+digest and rejects digest mismatch.

D3 — patternKey = sha256(canonical({cohortKey: episode.scopeKey, findingKind: normalized finding.kind, howAxis})). howAxis comes from PATTERN_POLICY_V1.findingKindToHowAxis; an unmapped finding kind is excluded with reason UNMAPPED_AXIS, never guessed.

D4 — Deduplication: a support unit is the sorted set of observation refs behind the episode's GroundedFindingInputs; retried or duplicated episodes with the same unit count once. supportingEpisodeRefs, outcomeCounts {IMPROVED, NO_CHANGE, REGRESSED, REJECTED_ACKNOWLEDGED} and contraryEvidenceRefs (episode contrary refs plus NO_CHANGE/REGRESSED episodes) are all retained.

D5 — Classification INSTANCE | RECURRING | SYSTEMIC: RECURRING when distinct support units >= policy.minSupport (>= 2); SYSTEMIC only when RECURRING and mechanismEvidence[{ref, digest, coveredEpisodeRefs}] resolves and covers every supporting episode, with contrary accounting recorded. Frequency alone never yields SYSTEMIC.

D6 — Reinforcement is recomputation: projectionId = sha256(canonical(policy digest + sorted input resolution refs)). New positive evidence changes only support metadata in a new projection; no escalation, response, acceptance or policy mutation is possible because the module has no write port.

D7 — HOW_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL_V1 = {patternProjectionRef+digest, patternKey, cohortEpisodeRefs, baselineHow:{policyHeadRef, strategyRef+digest}, allowedHowAxis, optimizer:{engine gepa, version 0.1.4, commit d771eb21b5dd3228bc3f567293d2ccfc423fc900, configDigest}, candidate:{strategyRef, digest, diff}, developmentEvidenceRefs, benchmarkAttemptRefs}. Eligible only from RECURRING or SYSTEMIC patterns. Keys accepted, promoted, approved, verdict or policyHead mutation fields are rejected at any depth.

D8 — Offline GEPA bridge reuses the BB-083 bridgeContract: one Node-owned child process per run, bounded bidirectional JSON-lines with explicit request ids and schema kinds, Python evaluation callbacks with no repository/benchmark/product mutation capability. Only trusted same-run local checkpoints load; pickle state is never ExHarness evidence.

D9 — Budget/crash/cancel: before each dispatch Node calls the delivered @exharness/benchmark AttemptLedger beginAttempt under a hard budget; denial returns a terminal BUDGET_DENIED to Python with no side effect. After crash Node reopens settled attempts by exact refs and reconciles STARTED-without-SETTLED attempts before any retry (retry = new attemptId with retryOfAttemptId). Cancellation never refunds a started reservation. Unknown usage/cost stays null.

D10 — IMPROVEMENT_EVALUATION_HANDOFF_V1 freezes before search: WHAT/acceptance refs+digests, baseline HOW head, optimizer identity/config, allowed axis, development/search-validation partition refs+digests, evaluator-owned final holdout ref+digest, metricPolicy ref+digest with minEffect, and model/provider/tool/budget/evaluator identities. The bridge receives only development and search-validation case refs.

D11 — buildHowEvolutionHandoff maps the proposal to the delivered BB-059 HOW_EVOLUTION_FINDING and HOW_EVOLUTION_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL/v1 inputs; final baseline/candidate runs register as @exharness/benchmark units/attempts; stochastic model-backed cases need >= 3 paired repeats unless the frozen policy requires more. Critical per-case regression blocks promotion; missing evidence is INCONCLUSIVE; BB-059 alone can publish.

D12 — Worker-start preflight test/self-improve-dependency-contract.test.mjs asserts BB-085, BB-059 and BB-065 DONE with delivery receipts/Living refs and package-root exports (FeedbackResolution validator, HOW evolution protocol/finding builders and independent promotion entry, AttemptLedger and experiment/unit/evidence/accounting/audit contracts). Missing/incompatible export or deep import => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

D13 — Mapping from BB-083: this task owns BB-083 S5, S6, S7 and the ImprovementProposal half of S2 under new file names; BB-083 remains unmodified pending BB-082 objective supersession and its feedback-*.js and scripts/feedback/** paths are forbidden here.
implementationSlices: I1 — Dependency preflight [SI5]: implement test/self-improve-dependency-contract.test.mjs first per D12; any missing BB-085/BB-059/BB-065 delivery or export => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before product writes.

I2 — Pattern projection + reinforcement [SI1, INV-1, INV-2]: implement PATTERN_POLICY_V1 and projectImprovementPatterns per D2-D6 as a pure read-only function with exact ref+digest resolution, support-unit dedup, contrary retention and mechanism-gated SYSTEMIC.
I3 — Proposal envelope [SI2, INV-1]: implement HOW_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL_V1 validator/builder per D7 with eligibility and forbidden-authority-key rejection.

I4 — Offline GEPA bridge [SI3, INV-3]: implement scripts/self-improve/gepa-bridge.mjs, gepa_adapter.py and requirements.lock per D8-D9 against the pinned GEPA base API; bridge tests drive a deterministic Python protocol stub for crash-after-commit, replay, cancellation, hard-budget denial and malformed/timeout cases, plus a lock/pin conformance test.

I5 — Independent evaluation handoff [SI4, INV-4]: implement IMPROVEMENT_EVALUATION_HANDOFF_V1 and buildHowEvolutionHandoff per D10-D11; prove holdout exclusion from bridge input, freeze-before-search immutability and mapping to BB-059 protocol inputs without calling a publisher.

I6 — Living truth [SI5]: add docs/living/system/agentic-application/self-improvement.md describing only delivered pattern/proposal/bridge/handoff contracts, authority limits and unevaluated effectiveness; export new names; run agentic and repository regressions.

negativeVerificationCases: A FeedbackResolution ref whose digest mismatches its artifact, or a non-resolution artifact, is rejected by the projection.
Two episodes backed by the same observation-ref set, or a retried episode, count as one support unit.
A SUPERSEDED resolution contributes only through its successor and is never double counted.
An unmapped finding kind is excluded with UNMAPPED_AXIS and never assigned a guessed HOW axis.
RECURRING support without mechanism evidence, or mechanism evidence that does not cover every supporting episode, never classifies SYSTEMIC.
NO_CHANGE and REGRESSED episodes and episode contrary refs remain in contrary evidence; adding positive episodes changes only support metadata and projectionId.
The projection module exposes no write port; attempts to change response, acceptance, promotion or policy head are impossible and tested by module surface inspection.
A proposal from an INSTANCE pattern, with more than one HOW axis, an unpinned optimizer identity or any accepted/promoted/approved/verdict/policy-head field is rejected.
A bridge evaluation request without a successful AttemptLedger reservation is never dispatched; over-budget requests return BUDGET_DENIED before dispatch.
Crash after a benchmark side effect but before acknowledgement reconciles the exact attempt before any retry; a STARTED-without-SETTLED attempt is never blindly redispatched.
Cancellation after dispatch keeps the reservation consumed and the attempt auditable; unknown usage/cost stays null, never zero.
Python attempting repository, benchmark-ledger, product-state or policy-head mutation has no capability path through the bridge; malformed, oversized or timed-out messages fail closed.
Loading an external or foreign-run GEPA pickle checkpoint is rejected; checkpoint state is never ExHarness evidence.
Any final-holdout case ref, holdout evidence, metric policy threshold or evaluator acceptance data appearing in bridge input invalidates the run.
Changing partitions, metric policy, minEffect, WHAT/acceptance, evaluator or fixed factors after search start invalidates the handoff.
Stochastic final comparison with fewer than three paired repeats per case is INCONCLUSIVE; a critical per-case regression blocks promotion even with aggregate gain.
buildHowEvolutionHandoff never calls a policy publisher; GEPA acceptance or aggregate gain cannot bypass BB-059 independent evaluation.
Worker start with BB-085, BB-059 or BB-065 not DONE, missing delivery receipt/Living refs, missing package-root export or a required deep import exits PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

Introducing LangMem, DSPy, LangGraph, gepa[full] or writes under packages/benchmark/**, HOW evolution owners, feedback lifecycle owners, scripts/feedback/** or docs/blackboard/** fail repository verification.
